column4: cleat#2887 (cleat#2249's deferred instance): this test guards on CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, which ci.yml's test-go/plugins job sets nowhere (that job's env is CLEAT_TEST_DB/CLEAT_CRASH_DB only, postgres service, no mysql or mssql service) -- so it skips once in this job while PostgreSQL-backed tests run. Dialect-gated, not a hidden failure: the test (plugins/webhookingest/a_v8_migration_survives_a_second_run_on_mysql_test.go) pins cleat-review's finding on #2221, a MySQL-specific idempotency defect in migration v8's UpMySQL that PostgreSQL and SQL Server never had. Measured by NAME with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL/CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL both unset and CLEAT_TEST_DB pointing at a postgres service: exactly one skip event for this test, 0 failures.
